content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Digital products

When evaluating options for selling digital products without Stripe, it's essential to consider what each platform or infrastructure actually offers. Gumroad, on the other hand, offers a more comprehensive platform, but its restrictions in certain regions make it unreliable. Similarly, Lemon Squeezy provides a payment solution, but its limited global reach means that creators must look elsewhere for reliable infrastructure. In contrast, a sovereign commerce infrastructure provides a complete digital commerce stack, including payment processing, order storage, and file delivery, without relying on limited platforms or restricted countries.
